title: TravelGuide
description: Travel guide article with destination information, tips, author, rating, and content. Used for travel blogs, destination guides, and travel information platforms.

id.description: Unique identifier for the travel guide

destination.description: Destination city or location the guide covers

content.description: Full travel guide content with information, recommendations, and advice

tips.description: Array of travel tips and recommendations

author.description: Full name of the travel guide author

rating.description: Average reader rating, typically on a scale of 1-5
